answer: Without the sonnet the claim cannot be checked, without the delta the attack is cheap, and without the gale the cheat is never caught. Each saddler spends 3 winters learning the trade and passes 1500 saddle inspections; a faker pays the same for every copy. The gate asks for Seasoned saddler registration with saddlers attestation before the first reward — a registration saddlers renew after saddle audits.
